problem: Roofing contractors handling insurance restoration claims lack a shared tool for project and customer tracking, transparency to homeowners and accountability across the claim process.
product_category: Roofing and restoration project management software

founders.name: Ryan Nichols
founders.background_notes: Named on the YC page; no background found.

technical_complexity.rationale: Project and customer tracking software for a niche vertical; standard web engineering.

defensibility.rationale: Workflow tool with possible lock in once contractors store claim records, but no stated moat.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Roofing CRMs such as AccuLynx and JobNimbus exist today; their 2016 positioning was not confirmed by dated sources.

market_need_then: YC page says contractors need transparency and accountability through the restoration claim process; no dated demand evidence found.

branding.domain_note: startclosing.com now redirects to a domain marketplace listing, which indicates the domain was not retained (fetched 2026).

brand_strength.rationale: No brand press found; the name is a generic sales phrase.

outcome_analysis: Start Closing was a two person Kansas startup selling tracking software to restoration roofers in YC Winter 2016. It is listed inactive, its domain now redirects to a name marketplace, and no post-mortem or news explains why, so the cause is not public and failure factors stay empty.
